assets.name: pulse
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Landscape 3:2 high-end playful independent creative studio campaign photograph for FICTIONAL audio brand PULSE. Chunky sculptural cobalt-blue over-ear headphones with small cream PULSE lettering, blue retail box with huge modern rounded cream PULSE typography, coiled citrus-yellow cable on a vivid pale acid-yellow set. A cream block and curved cobalt acrylic panel, art-directed asymmetry, close perspective, premium tangible materials, little natural scuff and believable reflections, polished commercial craft. Big dramatic simple objects, energetic but refined; headphones and packaging occupy 80% of frame. Color cobalt, buttery yellow, cream; not muted luxury beige. No actual brand logos, watermark, UI or collage. Exact brand text PULSE, minimal other text.

assets.name: grain
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Landscape 3:2 rich commercial photograph of a FICTIONAL specialty coffee brand GRAIN. Two tactile burnt-orange coffee bags with oversized deep forest-green custom serif text GRAIN, a short ivory ceramic cup of espresso, a chunky dark green clip and a few coffee beans on a warm cream surface. A human hand with natural skin texture casually holds a third small orange pack at the frame edge, correct anatomy, no face visible. Strong warm side light, visible crinkles in paper, subtle imperfect natural shadows, masterful product art direction with a human touch. Orange, dark green, ivory and coffee brown. Sophisticated playful packaging, confident large typography. No real brand or watermark, no UI, no collage.

assets.name: creative-table
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Landscape 3:2 candid editorial photograph illustrating creative work, NOT an actual agency office. Close view from above of two people's hands at a working design table. One hand holds a torn burnt-orange paper swatch over a cream mockup coffee bag marked GRAIN in dark green, another writes a small visual annotation with a dark pencil; correct natural hand anatomy, faces and bodies out of frame. A lavender NAYA cosmetic packaging concept, vivid cobalt art card, paper sketches of a four-point sparkle, gold foil sample, a small espresso and imperfect cut paper scraps. Lived-in tactile printed work, subtle ink marks and soft directional daylight, photoreal documentary texture, not a posed stock-office photo, not an overly tidy flat lay. Emerald, cream, burnt orange, cobalt and lilac. The hands and tactile detail are focal; no computer screens, no real brands, no Magic logo approximation, no watermark, no collage.
